clue.text: Location where one might serve drink before date

indicators.note: before places the drink ahead of the date in the answer

clue.text: Teams in Tbilisi despairing

clue.text: Not the usual litany: cup needs refreshing

clue.text: Walk from street and turn around

clue.text: Officer has little time for bed

clue.text: Tool, when turned, let us in

clue.text: Patient sort excited over railways, primarily?

definitions.text: Patient sort excited over railways, primarily?

excited means stirred up, so the letters of patient sort are thrown into a new order
primarily picks out only the first letter of railways

explanation.surface: A patient type who gets thrilled by railways above everything.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: a hobbyist who waits patiently on platforms, thrilled by railways, logging engine numbers.
explanation.definitionFit: A railway enthusiast who patiently notes the numbers of passing locomotives fits this whole description.

clue.text: Spirit key — might drinker need it?

a key is an opener, something that opens a lock

explanation.walkthrough: 'Spirit' looks like a strong drink, but it means courage, which British slang calls bottle.
explanation.definitionFit: A drinker wanting a beer would need a gadget for prising off the cap of a bottle.

clue.text: Elderly person lord set free

explanation.surface: An aged man set free by a nobleman.

clue.text: Article cheers Greek character

both cheers and ta are informal British ways of saying thank you

explanation.surface: A newspaper article celebrates a Greek personality.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Character' suggests a person, but here it means a letter of the alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the eighth letter of the Greek alphabet, a character in the written sense.

clue.text: Person who's up for trying something new?

definitions.text: Person who's up for trying something new?

parts.words: Person who's up for trying something new?
parts.note: up means in the air, and trying something new means flying a fresh, untried aircraft

explanation.walkthrough: 'Up for' reads as willing, but it also means airborne: this person flies new aircraft to try them out.

clue.text: Not beginning to play the guitar, boy musician

clue.text: Source of light in darkness, unbelievable

clue.text: Roughly ten diamonds to draw

parts.note: ice is slang for diamonds

clue.text: In most of Spanish dishes I love cold, starchy food

clue.text: Stop looking both ways?

parts.note: to halt a vehicle is to draw in at the kerb, and that phrase is itself a palindrome

clue.text: Oil wood on top of mantelpiece

parts.note: balsa is a very light wood

indicators.note: top of picks out the first letter of mantelpiece

explanation.surface: Wood oil applied to the top of a fireplace shelf.

clue.text: Fizzy drink for dad

definitions.meaning: a carbonated soft drink, named for the sound of its cork

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a carbonated soft drink and, informally, a father.

clue.text: Something poisonous dealt out, agony in it

clue.text: Perfect, one town in Kent

clue.text: Feature securing old rope

clue.text: Time about right, engine starts up

starts picks the first letters of about, right and engine

clue.text: Drunkard has arrived — that will teach you!

parts.note: a sot is a habitual drunk
someone who has arrived is here

explanation.surface: A drunk turns up as if to prove a point.
explanation.definitionFit: This childish retort crows over someone, much like saying that serves you right.

clue.text: Naval officer married Lara at sea
